title: REQ · Loading and empty history messages carry their own test ids
summary: History loading and empty messages are individually addressable
description: The loading message (L154) and the empty history message (L159) are plain role="status" paragraphs. Give each a data-testid so they cannot be confused with the success feedback or each other. Why: stable selectors.
acceptance_criteria: Given historyStatus is loading, when rendered, then an element with data-testid contribution-history-loading shows 'Loading your suggestions…'
Given history loaded with no entries, when rendered, then an element with data-testid contribution-history-empty shows the empty message

in_scope: data-testid on loading and empty paragraphs

definition_of_done: Both test ids present in rendered output
